changelog_text:
## Changes
- The gold foil (B) and white cloth (C) variants of the Facet Bus and the Battery Pack now cover most of each side face, with cut-outs for the radiator, the sensor window, the connectors and the wing fittings. Before, they changed only one small sheet.
- Facet Eye Imager B now has foil on its tube and on three faces of its mount.
- Wings and small parts still fit on the faces. Part Ids, colliders and masses are unchanged, so saved vehicles load as before.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.10.5801**.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineFacet\`.
No mod loader needed.

listing.abstract: Satellite parts for small launchers: a rideshare rack with 3U, 6U and 12U cube satellites, and a kit to build small satellites and probes, with a bus, solar wings, instruments, antennas and the Alcor kick engine.
listing.description:
![Facet cube satellites on the rack](ksa-image:hero)

**Facet** is a set of satellite parts for small launchers in Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**: a rideshare rack with cube satellites, and a kit to build small satellites and probes.

## Parts

- **Facet Cube Rack**: rideshare rack for cube satellites inside a fairing; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Cube Adapter 1 m to 0.5 m**: adapter from 1 m to 0.5 m; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Cube 3U**, **6U** and **12U**: cube satellites, two layouts each; the 12U unfolds its wings.
- **Facet Bus**: core of a small satellite or probe; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet Battery Pack**: battery pack for the Bus; bare, gold foil, white cloth.
- **Facet RCS Pod**: attitude control thrusters with their own tank.
- **Facet Wing 2** and **Wing 3**: folding solar wings with two or three panels.
- **Facet Eye Imager**: Earth observation telescope; bare or with foil.
- **Facet Camera Pod**, **Star Tracker**, **Horn Antenna** and **Patch Antenna**.
- **Facet Dish**: deploying dish antenna.
- **Facet Science Boom**: deploying science boom.
- **Facet Voyager Tank**: propellant tank of a small probe; bare or in silver foil.
- **Alcor Kick Engine**: kick engine on stock MMH and NTO.

Sizes and texture density follow the stock parts. A cube satellite leaves the rack with its decoupler and tumbles unless something controls it. A Bus rides on a stock 0.5 m decoupler.

![All parts and finishes](ksa-image:all-parts)

![Facet Eye](ksa-image:eye)

![Facet Voyager with the Alcor kick engine](ksa-image:voyager)

![Rideshare with white cloth](ksa-image:rideshare-cloth)

## Requirements

No other mod needed. Facet works with any launcher that has a fairing. [Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-PurrlinePrisma) is a small launcher with a fairing for Facet.

## Install

- Borea: install Facet from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineFacet` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.10.5801.
